    return node

|---|---|---|

class HashMap:
    def __init__(self, cap=8):
        self.buckets = [[] for _ in range(cap)]
        self.size = 0

    def put(self, k, v):
        i = hash(k) % len(self.buckets)
        for j, (kk, vv) in enumerate(self.buckets[i]):
            if kk == k:
                self.buckets[i][j] = (k, v); return
        self.buckets[i].append((k, v))
        self.size += 1
        if self.size / len(self.buckets) > 0.75:
            self._resize()

    def _resize(self):
        old = self.buckets
        self.buckets = [[] for _ in range(len(old) * 2)]
        self.size = 0
        for bucket in old:
            for k, v in bucket:
                self.put(k, v)

    def get(self, k):
        i = hash(k) % len(self.buckets)
        for kk, vv in self.buckets[i]:
            if kk == k: return vv
        raise KeyError(k)
